open-desert-multiplayer-loot-contention.description: Two marksmen (scenario command steps inject weapons) and one loot-bearing rogue for damage-ledger loot-right contention.
open-desert-multiplayer-loot-contention.notes: Scenario command steps explicitly grant marksman novice, a debug-equipped Slugthrower, and ammo to both players so real character joins can stay doctrine-bare. Alpha solos rogue to health<70 of 160 (lead>=90 > 70 remaining => deterministic ledger winner). Beta assists; lootRightsActorId=mp-loot-alpha; beta honest loot_no_rights; alpha loots.

open-desert-multiplayer-loot-restart-cac.description: Dedicated two-player corpse-right contention fixture with one nearby sealed cache for restart-only source persistence and terminal-lifecycle proof.
open-desert-multiplayer-loot-restart-cac.notes: Dedicated restart-only fixture: alpha earns the corpse right after the normal damage ledger and cache:mp-loot-restart-cache provides a second exact source whose terminal state is externally observable as loot_not_lootable on a duplicate take. The shared loot-contention fixture remains unchanged for non-restart coverage.

open-desert-multiplayer-assist.description: Two explicitly armed marksmen and one high-health rogue for two-on-one assist receipts and full kill-ledger XP.

BOTH mp-assist-alpha AND mp-assist-beta land damaging hits and receive marksman slugthrower XP under the current full-kill-ledger XP rule.

open-desert-multiplayer-aoi.description: Stationary observer (alpha) far from base actors + a mover (beta) starting inside alpha's AOI, then exiting it, for honest AOI removal (no ghost).
open-desert-multiplayer-aoi.notes: Alpha at (30,990) is isolated from base actors. Beta starts at x=172 inside alpha's warm AOI, then deterministic bounded movement carries it beyond the exit boundary without relying on realtime scheduling.

open-desert-multiplayer-trade.description: Three nearby players with exact-variant Iron rows for shared exchange contention and a funded two-sided atomic trade.
open-desert-multiplayer-trade.notes: Alpha and beta each own five Iron units at exact variant 211337 for shared-exchange isolation, beta has the variant-0 Iron trade offer, and both actors have exact 5,000-credit fresh-character wallets. Gamma exists solely to decline a second real invite, leaving alpha/beta's formed group and leadership continuity unambiguous. The district exchange terminal is adjacent to all three actors.

open-desert-multiplayer-extractor.description: Two players over a mineral spawn: owner alpha places/collects an extractor; non-owner beta is rejected with not_extractor_owner.

open-desert-core-world-restart.description: Isolated core-world persistence fixture: Dustgate player plus a nearby authored patient for exact inventory, profession, travel/door, camp, service-buff, wound, and revive restart contracts.

All scenario mutations use real authority commands. The authored rogue patient is downed only through live combat, then restored only through ReviveActor; no debug grant or forced lifecycle state is supplied.

open-desert-active-systems-restart.description: Isolated active-systems restart fixture with real crafting, survey, extraction, bioengineering, and roll-combat preconditions.

Every active cross-restart state is then opened through ordinary authority verbs; the fixture supplies deterministic tools, materials, and nearby trainer/hostile only.

open-desert-guild-lifecycle.description: Four legitimate, credit-funded characters around the final Dustgate PA terminal for guild lifecycle, privacy, chat, war, and restart proof.

The fixture supplies four ordinary character records with 300000 credits; each charter must debit exactly 250000 from the authority wallet. Runtime requires the regenerated dustgate-pa-terminal prop at cell (509,501) in open-desert-overworld.

open-desert-multiplayer-duel.description: Two fully equipped marksmen at point-blank range for an authority-only consent duel, scoped damage, and honorable yield.
open-desert-multiplayer-duel.notes: No scenario-time grants: alpha's Slugthrower (3101), Iron Slugs (1101), and Rifle III cert are fixture state. Beta is a real, nearby second player and may yield after the scoped exchange.
